Indian youths lured to Myanmar with fake job offers

A graphic designer from Beed, Maharashtra, was trafficked to Myanmar after responding to a fake job ad. This incident is part of a larger issue where many Indian youths have been trapped near the Thailand-Myanmar border after being lured by fake data entry job offers. The police have confirmed that hundreds of Indians are involved in cyber fraud operations in Myanmar.
